analysis.insight_summary: Forum users are struggling to access specific tools from [company_name], such as [product_name] V2.0 and [product_name] V1.0, after a website redesign removed official individual download links. Users are now forced to download oversized update bundles which contain several unnecessary components, leading to inconvenience and frustration especially when particular files like .xlam are needed for work.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want to be able to conveniently and directly download targeted tools such as [product_name] and [product_name], without needing to download or navigate larger bundled packages or outdated links.
